changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: pull_request_review, issue, user, identity_provider and activity_event are required to correct GitLab review rows

changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM activity_event WHERE event_type = 'REVIEW_CHANGES_REQUESTED' AND target_type = 'review' AND target_id IN ( SELECT r.id FROM pull_request_review r JOIN issue i ON i.id = r.pull_request_id JOIN "user" u ON u.id = r.author_id JOIN identity_provider p ON p.id = r.provider_id WHERE p.type = 'GITLAB' AND r.state = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' AND r.native_id = (((i.native_id & 4294967295) << 32) | (u.native_id & 4294967295)) & 9223372036854775807)

UPDATE pull_request_review r SET state = 'DISMISSED', is_dismissed = true FROM issue i, "user" u, identity_provider p WHERE i.id = r.pull_request_id AND u.id = r.author_id AND p.id = r.provider_id AND p.type = 'GITLAB' AND r.state = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' AND r.native_id = (((i.native_id & 4294967295) << 32) | (u.native_id & 4294967295)) & 9223372036854775807

rollback.stop: Which approval rows were turned into requests for changes is not recorded; restore a pre-upgrade database backup.

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: issue.review_decision is required to correct GitLab review decisions

changeSet.sql: UPDATE issue i SET review_decision = NULL WHERE i.issue_type = 'PULL_REQUEST' AND i.review_decision = 'APPROVED' AND i.provider_id IN (SELECT id FROM identity_provider WHERE type = 'GITLAB') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_review r WHERE r.pull_request_id = i.id AND r.state = 'APPROVED')

rollback.stop: Which review decisions were cleared is not recorded; restore a pre-upgrade database backup.
